sources.title: Oral supplementation of specific collagen peptides has beneficial effects on human skin physiology: a double-blind, placebo-controlled study
sources.authors: Proksch E, Segger D, Degwert J, Schunck M, Sattler W, Oesser S
sources.key_finding: 2.5 g/day bioactive collagen peptides (VERISOL) for 8 weeks → 20% wrinkle reduction + 65% procollagen I increase in biopsy (n=114 women, 45-65y)

sources.title: Pathophysiology of premature skin aging induced by ultraviolet light
sources.authors: Fisher GJ, Wang ZQ, Datta SC, Varani J, Kang S, Voorhees JJ
sources.key_finding: Single UV exposure (2 MED) induces MMP-1 collagenase mRNA and protein in human skin within 8-24 hours — mechanistic basis of photoaging

sources.title: Photoaging: mechanisms and repair
sources.authors: Friedman PM, Jih MH, Kimyai-Asadi A, Goldberg LH
sources.key_finding: ~80-90% of visible facial aging attributable to UV exposure (photoaging) — comprehensive mechanism review

sources.title: The effect of niacinamide on reducing cutaneous pigmentation and suppression of melanosome transfer
sources.authors: Hakozaki T, Minwalla L, Zhuang J, Chhoa M, Matsubara A, Miyamoto K, Greatens A, Hillebrand GG, Bissett DL, Boissy RE
sources.key_finding: 5% topical niacinamide for 8 weeks significantly reduced hyperpigmentation; in vitro melanosome transfer inhibited 35-68% via PAR-2 blockade

sources.title: Sunscreen and prevention of skin aging: a randomized trial
sources.authors: Hughes MC, Williams GM, Baker P, Green AC
sources.key_finding: 4.5-year RCT (n=903): daily SPF15+ sunscreen users showed 24% less photoaging vs discretionary use — first prospective RCT evidence for sunscreen anti-aging benefit

sources.org: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology
sources.title: Topical tretinoin for photoaged skin
sources.authors: Kligman AM, Grove GL, Hirose R, Leyden JJ
sources.key_finding: Landmark RCT establishing tretinoin as first topical agent to reverse photoaging — increased procollagen, reduced wrinkles, improved skin texture

sources.title: Restoration of collagen formation in photodamaged human skin by tretinoin (retinoic acid)
sources.authors: Griffiths CE, Russman AN, Majmudar G, Singer RS, Hamilton TA, Voorhees JJ
sources.key_finding: Tretinoin 0.1% for 10-12 months increased procollagen I by 80% in photodamaged dermis — in vivo biopsy mechanistic evidence

sources.title: Topical L-ascorbic acid: percutaneous absorption studies
sources.authors: Pinnell SR, Yang H, Omar M, Monteiro-Riviere N, DeBuys HV, Walker LC, Wang Y, Levine M
sources.key_finding: pH <3.5 and 10-20% concentration required for effective skin penetration of L-ascorbic acid — foundational formulation science

sources.org: Clinical, Cosmetic and Investigational Dermatology / PubMed
sources.title: Glutathione as a skin whitening agent: facts, myths, evidence and controversies
sources.authors: Sonthalia S, Daulatabad D, Sarkar R
sources.key_finding: Comprehensive review of GSH skin lightening: oral bioavailability low (<2%), IV GSH risks include Stevens-Johnson syndrome/TEN/renal failure; FDA Philippines 2011 warning cited

sources.title: The influence of age and sex on skin thickness, skin collagen and density
sources.authors: Shuster S, Black MM, McVitie E
sources.key_finding: Dermal collagen content declines ~1% per year after age 20 — foundational measurement of age-related collagen loss

sources.title: Skin collagen changes in postmenopausal women receiving different regimens of estrogen therapy
sources.authors: Brincat M, Moniz CF, Studd JW, Darby AJ, Magos A, Cooper D
sources.key_finding: Postmenopausal women lose ~30% of skin collagen in first 5 years after menopause, then ~2.1%/year thereafter

sources.title: Pentosidine and advanced glycosylation end products in aging and diabetes
sources.authors: Sell DR, Monnier VM
sources.key_finding: Pentosidine (AGE crosslink) accumulates in skin collagen with age and hyperglycemia — ~2× increase from age 20 to 80

sources.title: Cosmetic benefits of astaxanthin on human subjects
sources.authors: Tominaga K, Hongo N, Karato M, Yamashita E
sources.key_finding: Oral astaxanthin (6 mg/day, 8 weeks) improved wrinkle depth and skin elasticity; combined oral+topical showed better results in RCT

sources.title: The Protective Role of Astaxanthin for UV-Induced Skin Deterioration in Healthy People
sources.authors: Ito N, Seki S, Ueda F
sources.key_finding: Oral astaxanthin 12 mg/day (n=65) for 16 weeks — significant reduction in UV-induced skin deterioration including moisture loss and wrinkle depth

sources.title: Does poor sleep quality affect skin ageing?
sources.authors: Oyetakin-White P, Suggs A, Koo B, Matsui MS, Yarosh D, Cooper KD, Baron ED
sources.key_finding: Poor sleepers (<6hr/night) showed significantly higher skin-aging (SCINEXA) scores and ~2× slower skin barrier recovery vs good sleepers

sources.org: Journal of Investigative Dermatology Symposium Proceedings / PubMed
sources.title: Stratum corneum and beyond
sources.authors: Elias PM
sources.key_finding: Comprehensive review of stratum corneum biology — brick-and-mortar model, TEWL, ceramide composition, barrier repair — foundational reference

sources.org: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology / PubMed
sources.title: Melasma: an up-to-date comprehensive review
sources.authors: Sheth VM, Pandya AG
sources.key_finding: Comprehensive melasma review — estrogen receptor expression on melanocytes, triggers (UV, hormones, heat), treatment evidence (hydroquinone, tretinoin, tranexamic acid)

sources.org: Journal of Drugs in Dermatology / PubMed
sources.title: The role of zinc in the treatment of acne: A review of the literature
sources.authors: Cervantes J, Eber AE, Perper M, Nascimento VM, Nouri K, Keri JE
sources.key_finding: Zinc supplementation ~30 mg/day (elemental) reduces inflammatory acne lesions by 40-50% over 12 weeks; mechanism: 5α-reductase inhibition + C. acnes antibacterial

sources.title: UV radiation and the skin
sources.authors: Matsumura Y, Ananthaswamy HN
sources.key_finding: UVA penetrates 20-50% to dermis; UVB absorbed primarily in epidermis — UVA = aging, UVB = burning/carcinogenesis mechanistic basis

sources.title: Dietary tomato paste protects against ultraviolet light-induced erythema in humans
sources.authors: Stahl W, Heinrich U, Wiseman S, Eichler O, Sies H, Tronnier H
sources.key_finding: Oral lycopene 10-40 mg/day for 10-12 weeks increased MED by ~20-40% — equivalent to internal SPF ~1.3-1.5 photoprotection

sources.title: Topical retinoids in clinical practice: a reference guide
sources.authors: Mukherjee S, Date A, Patravale V, Korting HC, Roeder A, Weindl G
sources.key_finding: Comprehensive retinoid review — OTC retinol ~1/10-1/20 potency vs tretinoin due to 2-step conversion; clinical evidence summary for anti-aging

sources.title: Sunscreen FAQs — SPF, UVA/UVB, broad-spectrum, application amount
sources.authors: AAD Editorial Board
sources.key_finding: AAD guidelines: SPF 30 blocks 97%, SPF 50 blocks 98%; recommended application 2 mg/cm²; broad-spectrum protection required

sources.title: Hyperpigmentation: overview, causes, and treatment — AAD
sources.authors: AAD Editorial Board
sources.key_finding: AAD position: supplements can even out tone (reverse acquired hyperpigmentation) but cannot lighten below genetic baseline — genetic ceiling concept

sources.title: Astaxanthin: A Review of its Chemistry and Applications
sources.authors: Ambati RR, Phang SM, Ravi S, Aswathanarayana RG
sources.key_finding: Astaxanthin structure enables membrane-spanning singlet oxygen quenching; ~100× β-carotene in vitro; anti-inflammatory via NF-κB suppression

sources.title: How to Improve Your Skin Health & Appearance — Huberman Lab Podcast (Episode ~150)
sources.authors: Andrew Huberman (Stanford University, Dept. Ophthalmology & Neuroscience)
sources.key_finding: Covers collagen loss mechanism, retinol/tretinoin evidence, niacinamide, sunscreen necessity, sleep-skin connection, vitamin C — popularized skin science for mass audience
sources.citation_notes: Huberman is NOT a dermatologist — cite only when aligns with peer-reviewed sources; good for popular framing but verify all claims against primary literature

sources.org: Da Capo Press / Whitney Bowe MD
sources.title: The Beauty of Dirty Skin — Whitney Bowe MD
sources.authors: Whitney Bowe, MD (board-certified dermatologist, NYC)
sources.key_finding: Popularized gut-skin axis concept for general audience; covers microbiome, inflammation, skin barrier — good framing for UncleD lifestyle content
sources.citation_notes: Board-certified dermatologist; popular book rather than peer-reviewed — use for general framing, verify specific claims against primary literature

sources.org: Journal of Clinical and Aesthetic Dermatology / PubMed
sources.title: The role of inflammation in the pathology of acne
sources.authors: Tanghetti EA
sources.key_finding: Adult female acne prevalence ~22% in women 25-45; jawline/chin U-zone pattern; inflammatory cascade via C. acnes + TLR-2 documented

sources.title: The skin barrier: lipids and structure
sources.authors: Feingold KR
sources.key_finding: Stratum corneum lipid composition: ~50% ceramides, ~25% cholesterol, ~15% FFA — disruption underlies atopic dermatitis and barrier disorders
